settings.q: How big can it be made?

settings.q: Is it suitable for indoor and outdoor display?
settings.a: Its only suitable for indoor environment. For outdoor we use different material which will be custom commission.

settings.hero_desc: A bold, large-scale abstract sculpture built from faceted geometric blocks in a vivid colour gradient. A statement art piece for lobbies, showrooms and public spaces - designed and finished to your size, palette and form.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your form, colour palette and size
settings.s1_body: This large abstract sculpture turns a faceted, geometric form into a riot of colour - a piece that anchors a lobby, showroom or public space and gives it identity. We design the form and colour story with you, then build and finish it at scale. Whether you want a bold rainbow gradient or a restrained brand palette, the result is a one-of-a-kind centrepiece.
settings.case_body: Created as a statement installation, this faceted sculpture gives an interior an instant focal point and talking piece. We tailor the shape, scale and colours to the space and the brand, so every piece is unique to its setting.
settings.case_quote: It completely changed the feel of our entrance - everyone stops to look at it.
settings.prov_p: Abstract sculpture gives a space character without saying a word. Built large and finished in vivid colour, it becomes the piece people remember and photograph. Colour you can walk around.
